description.value: You've balanced on live power lines strung across the Slums for coin. You're not off-guard from being on narrow or uneven surfaces, and a critical failure to Balance on such a surface is treated as a normal failure instead.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Not off-guard from being on narrow or uneven surfaces' has no rule element removing a terrain-caused off-guard status, and the Balance critical-failure downgrade is gated on the same kind of surface-condition roll option that real Rock Runner's own terrain:stone/terrain:earth predicates turn out not to have a working hook for either (see the terrain-enum finding on several other cards in this batch) -- neither clause has anything solid to predicate on.
